changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedAsset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionDeletedAsset]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [IntersectID] [int] NULL, [FromHierarchy] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_FromHierarchy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [Level] [int] NULL, [Cascade] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Cascade] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Asset') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Asset] ON [api].[ExecutionDeletedAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [AssetID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Intersect') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Intersect] ON [api].[ExecutionDeletedAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [IntersectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Object') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Object] ON [api].[ExecutionDeletedAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Success') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionDeletedAsset_Success] ON [api].[ExecutionDeletedAsset] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [Success] ASC ) INCLUDE([ItemNumber]) END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionDeletedAsset' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Level') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionDeletedAsset] add [Level] int null end
